caption:
A single price gives the customer one comparison: cheaper or not.

Three tiers change the question. Good, Better, Best. Same job, three scopes, and the customer picks inside your options instead of shopping you against a competitor.

The build:
1. Your normal quote becomes the middle tier.
2. Cut two line items for the lower tier. Never touch safety items.
3. Add a faster timeline, premium material, or longer warranty for the top tier. List it first so it sets the anchor.

Run it on your next ten quotes and watch which tier gets picked.

rationale: Carousels lead saves/depth for B2B authority content in 2026 benchmarks, and this ships an unclaimed pricing-structure framework (tiered quoting) distinct from every prior stage, ladder, matrix, segmentation, and cadence model already covered.
